title: Improving Myoelectric Prosthetic and Orthotic Limb Control
official: Improving Myoelectric Prosthetic and Orthotic Limb Control Using Predictive Regression Algorithms and High-count Surface Electrodes
summary: The purpose of this study is to improve control of myoelectrically-controlled advanced orthotic devices (an exoskeleton device that use the body's muscle signals to drive movements of a robotic brace) by using advanced predictive decode algorithms, and the use of high count (\> 8) surface electromyographic (sEMG) electrodes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* First-ever ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke
* Chronic Stroke (at least 6 months since onset)
* Chronic hemiparesis
* Functional range of motion for contralateral arm

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals who are currently Incarcerated
